title: Next up says how to extract
caption: At level 10 the Extract card now says what to click: open the Cube, click the old piece, choose Extract and confirm.

title: The rest of the step behind i
caption: Tapping i under a step card shows the step's other notes, the same way the Sealed Dungeon and Stronghold cards do.

title: Cube items show their icons
caption: The Use your Cube items card shows the Wisdom Stone and Daevanion Crystal icons next to their counts.

title: Item links in a step show the item
caption: When a step names Daevanion Crystals, Wisdom Stones or Enhance Stones, its Next up card shows the item's icon in the link.

title: Sealed Dungeon rewards with icons
caption: A Sealed Dungeon card's reward line (behind i) shows the crystal and Wisdom Stone icons.

title: The how line on desktop
caption: On a wide screen the step card's how line fits on one line under the title, with the milestone line below it.
